receipt_schema.identity_rule: source and module identify each arm and may differ; metric_version and every other exact top-level receipt key named by match_identity.required_equal_fields is captured in required_per_arm_fields and must match; rune_sha256 pins the complete artifact while rune_identity records the current runtime map and movement-law fields

event_authority.steal: production F Pickup score event reconciled exactly with STATS_OFFENSE_FLAG
event_authority.capture: production CTF capture stats and host outcome log, reconciled exactly
event_authority.approach: serverrecord geometry crossing from outside to inside 384 horizontal units of the live enemy stand
event_authority.close_conversion: first authoritative carry start no later than 1.5 seconds after a qualifying approach
event_authority.demo_capture: diagnostic only; outcomecard 280-unit carry-end inference is never authoritative

metric_calculation.evaluation_window: half-open [t0,t0+600.0) server-time interval where t0 is the last authoritative PlayerTeamChange roster-join timestamp; all ten roster clients must remain continuously joined through t0+600.0
metric_calculation.active_bot_minutes: clip the exact ten-bot roster to the evaluation window: 10 bots times 600.0 seconds divided by 60
metric_calculation.active_team_minutes: clip each full five-bot team to the evaluation window: two teams times 600.0 seconds divided by 60
metric_calculation.active_defender_minutes: emitted diagnostic SG telemetry samples inside the conservative authoritative log brackets with role=1 divided by 60; no death-time samples are fabricated
metric_calculation.telemetry_time_alignment: SG Think_Emit rows are absent while a bot is dead and are not a clock: retain emitted rows in server-log order after the final roster-join line through the last host outcome whose matched StdLog timestamp is strictly before t0+600.0; report the cutoff gap and reject malformed, duplicate, or out-of-order emitted rows
metric_calculation.horizontal_distance: sum serverrecord 10 Hz consecutive-frame horizontal steps whose second frame is in the evaluation window and no greater than film.TELEPORT_UNITS=180; divide by active bot minutes
metric_calculation.moving_sample_fraction: cropped one-second SG telemetry samples with horizontal spd greater than 50 divided by all cropped recognized SG samples
metric_calculation.world_or_hazard_suicides: timestamped StdLog Suicide events in the evaluation window summed over the roster; complete-stream totals reconcile to fresh unified game_stats.suicides and conservatively include self-weapon suicides
metric_calculation.combat: timestamped StdLog Kill attacker and victim events in the evaluation window summed over the roster; complete-stream totals reconcile to fresh unified game_stats.frags and game_stats.fragged; divide each by active team minutes
metric_calculation.visible_or_audible_engagements: cropped one-second SG telemetry samples with eng=1, whose production source is a current visible target; recent unseen damage evidence may admit a visible rear-cone scan but is not itself an engagement; divide by active team minutes
metric_calculation.forbidden_knowledge_events: failures from executable production-policy checks covering missing or carried, unseen dropped, wrong-floor, or hull-blocked flag facts, plus every runtime FLAG_KNOWLEDGE_VIOLATION marker if one is emitted; absence of a marker does not replace the policy checks
metric_calculation.approach: serverrecord consecutive-frame crossing whose second frame is in the evaluation window from horizontal distance at least 384 to less than 384 from the authenticated enemy stand while the complete level-start production F Pickup, FC LostFlag, F Return, and F Capture timeline says that flag is home; a dropped flag remains dropped at droptime+30 and returns only when the production ctf_flagwave comparison level.time > droptime+30 fires; flag events must be sorted by timestamp and unique integer production log_order, and same-timestamp events execute in ascending production log order
metric_calculation.demo_time_alignment: median over the ten roster clients of StdLog PlayerConnect seconds minus first serverrecord entity-frame seconds; every effects carry start must reconcile to an authoritative same-player F Pickup within 0.2 seconds
metric_calculation.close_conversion: authoritative same-player F Pickup from 0.0 through 1.5 seconds after a qualifying approach; one pickup and one approach may be matched at most once
metric_calculation.steal: timestamped StdLog F Pickup events in the evaluation window divided by active team minutes; the complete timestamped stream must exactly equal host stole outcomes and fresh unified ctf_stats.flag_pickups
metric_calculation.capture: timestamped StdLog F Capture events in the evaluation window divided by active team minutes; the complete timestamped stream must exactly equal host captured outcomes and fresh unified ctf_stats.flag_captures
metric_calculation.steal_to_capture_conversion: authoritative capture count divided by authoritative F Pickup count
metric_calculation.defender_post_dwell_fraction: cropped role=1 SG telemetry samples with 0 <= sgoal < 1500 divided by all cropped role=1 samples
metric_calculation.defender_moving_sample_fraction: cropped role=1 SG telemetry samples with horizontal spd greater than 50 divided by all cropped role=1 samples
metric_calculation.defender_departure: per bot, a consecutive cropped role=1 telemetry transition from 0 <= sgoal < 1500 to sgoal >= 1500; divide by active defender minutes
metric_calculation.captures_conceded: opponent authoritative captures divided by that team's active team minutes
metric_calculation.strata_and_pooling: emit map, team, roster-size, configuration, and round strata; decision bands use the paired aggregate formed only by summing identical map, roster-size, and configuration strata after team strata are reported

decision.zero_baseline_ratio_rule: apply the paired absolute-delta and count rule; do not manufacture a ratio
decision.failure_rule: strike or revise the candidate; retain counter-evidence
